summarize_all: summarize the polars vertical aggregation function all for bitwise AND or selecting all columns
test_any: test the polars vertical aggregation function any for bitwise OR evaluation
build_max: build a polars aggregation expression to get the maximum value of one or more columns
build_min: build a polars aggregation expression to get the minimum value of one or more columns
create_sum: create a polars aggregation expression to sum all values in one or more columns
run_cum_sum: run a polars aggregation expression to cumulatively sum all values in one or more columns
